origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): the relay answers with reasoning and no text and no call, ending with stop. A Gemini client is rendered an empty text part and STOP, and the answer is charged as any other (the Messages entry treats the same answer as an interruption; for the Gemini entry nobody has decided it, and this case pins what is done). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
